chrome.note: Tabs, command palette, modals and the shared toolbar. A pane story may restyle chrome, but every control here stays reachable: the inventory test fails if one disappears.

rollback.strategy: One story, one merge commit. Revert the merge, not the individual commits, so the reverted tree is the tree that ran green before the story.
steps: Identify the story's merge commit: `git log --merges --oneline --grep 'UIUX-<story>' origin/main`.
Revert it: `git revert -m 1 <merge-sha>` on a branch, then open a pull request that names the story.

Regenerate the derived artifacts if the revert changed any pinned file: `python3 scripts/uiux_source_manifest.py`, `scripts/uiux_control_inventory.py`, `scripts/uiux_route_map.py`, `scripts/uiux_authorization_trace.py`, `scripts/uiux_preservation_signoff.py`.
Re-run the verification commands below and record their exit codes in the ledger.
not_touched: This package adds no database migration. A Git revert does not roll back durable database state; each future story must separately verify its migration and recovery effects.
This package adds no privilege: the bearer token, host allowlist, origin check, rate limit and body-size limit are not changed by it.
A revert changes tracked files in the target checkout, not arbitrary external workspaces. Review the target and protect uncommitted work before running it.

not_verified: Nothing here was rendered or clicked. A control counted in the markup is present in the file, not proven to work, and no keyboard, contrast or screen-reader check has been run.

Pane-to-route attribution follows calls inside the inline script at most 2 hops from the handler a control names, and keeps a route only when the walk passes the function that supplied its literal. A deeper chain is invisible, so a pane with no routes below is not a pane that calls nothing; the excluded count on each pane shows the filter refusing a shared helper's other callers.
The route map is a bounded lexical scan, not proof of exhaustive browser coverage or execution. Unresolved URL or method edges remain visible; no observed caller is not proof of absence.

The preservation matrix is a list of capabilities in words. This package carries it row for row and does not decide which control implements which row; that mapping is what the owner is being asked to confirm.
6 of 6 baseline screenshots are recorded. Missing or unaccepted screenshots leave the visual gate open; static artifacts cannot substitute for them.
The demo and full test suite can use source-relative harness data; until isolation is fixed, run them only from a disposable checkout with an empty harness store (issues #108 and #117).

Approval is an owner act recorded in the ledger. The generator cannot authenticate the signer or prove that the recorded reference authorizes its digests. A green test suite proves neither acceptability nor that other P0 holds are cleared.
